evals.prompt: Create a PRD for a new user notifications feature.
evals.expected_output: Enter Discovery Phase: ask 3-5 clarifying questions with options. (a) Platform: Web/Mobile/Both? (b) Notification types: in-app/email/push? (c) Real-time or batched? (d) User preferences/opt-out required? (e) Target user roles? Repeat until Actionable State reached, then draft to docs/prd/prd-user-notifications.md.

evals.prompt: I need a spec for making the app faster.
evals.expected_output: Violation: 'faster' is vague. Apply No Vagueness rule: ask for measurable targets. 'Fast' -> 'Load time < 200ms'. Discovery questions: (a) Which pages/flows are slow? (b) Current measured baseline? (c) Target SLA? (d) Platform? Map answers to non-functional requirements section of PRD template.

assertions.description: Accepts the original or an equivalent skill-visible outcome

evals.prompt: Draft requirements for a payment checkout flow.
evals.expected_output: Discovery Phase: ask about payment providers (Stripe/PayPal), currencies supported, guest vs. account checkout, 3DS requirements, refund flows, mobile vs. web. Verification checklist: functional flows defined, edge cases (failed payment, timeout, duplicate submit), security requirements (PCI compliance), performance targets. Write to docs/prd/prd-checkout-flow.md.

evals.prompt: The code seems already done, but we do not have PRD or acceptance criteria.
evals.expected_output: Report partial or unverified status, separate implementation evidence from missing requirements evidence, route to PM-owned plan-feature, and require REQ/AC IDs before implementation closure.

evals.prompt: We are an offshore delivery team; plan this feature before dev starts.
evals.expected_output: Include PM-owned PRD, BA/PM/RACI, rollout/ops, validation owner, acceptance criteria IDs, and implementation-readiness before dev tasks.
